note: Illinois Department of Agriculture campground on the State Fairgrounds in Springfield, open to the public outside events; a host assigns sites on arrival. Full during the State Fair in August and busy during horse shows. Near the Lincoln historic sites. --Claude
summary: Both fairgrounds camping pages read: 300 sites with electric and water, limited sewer, showers; open to the general public April 1-October 31 (closed November-March, so stored year_round was wrong); $35 regular ($40 holiday weeks/outside the main campground, $50 State Fair, $30 seniors/veterans); no reservations, first come first served. Phone 217-524-9894 (none stored).
